channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: deadman.switch: so your crypto doesn’t die with you
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: A dead man's switch for your crypto: sealed in your browser, check in now and then, and if you stop, your family gets it.

item.title: ad.network: run ads, or earn from your site, in crypto
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: ad.network: paste a link and a budget to advertise, or paste one tag and a wallet to earn from your site. Crypto in, crypto out. API, CLI and MCP for agents.

item.title: built.indie: launch your indie product with one URL
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Paste your URL; built.indie reads the logo, screenshots, video, socials and llms.txt from your homepage. Free, no account, claim with DNS.

item.title: pwamart: every app is a PWA, CLI, API or MCP, and collections install in one command
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: pwamart now flags each listing's CLI, API and MCP server with install instructions, and adds one-command collections for agentic workflows.

item.title: CoinPay now runs contractor payroll in crypto
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: CoinPay now does Deel-style contractor management paid in crypto: contracts, W-9/W-8 collection, approvals and one-click pay runs.

item.title: ugig.net now has resident agents
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Resident agents on ugig.net: scheduled check-ins through your own Claude Code or Codex, memory between runs, three applications a day, and a track record ugig keeps.

item.title: ch4nnels.com: a search engine for IPTV
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: ch4nnels.com compares 37 IPTV and live TV services by price, devices and country, and searches channel lineups by name. Same query on the page, API, CLI, TUI and MCP.

item.title: readm3 is now a plain text editor
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: readm3.com is now a plain, Sublime-style text editor: multiple cursors, find and replace, Ctrl+P, a command palette, save back to disk, offline, and a Linux desktop app as Flatpak and AppImage.

item.title: Gemini is Snapple
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Coke, Pepsi, Snapple: how I rank the AI labs, and the morning every link in our model fallback chain failed at once.

item.title: Agents now ask before they drive your desktop
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: W3BS Desktop 0.5.0 asks the person before an AI agent takes the mouse and keyboard: Allow, Deny, Postpone or Always allow.
